en: The switch turned off.{w}
The switch turned on.{w}
There's a ladder. Climb up?
There's a ladder. Climb down?
You are inside solid rock
note: Banner text (op096, like the spinner/chute banners). Nod to Wizardry's classic 'in rock' teleport death; kept as a plain statement.

en: Climbing down this ladder should let you board the ship.{w}
Board the ship?
Climbing up this ladder should get you back ashore.{w}
Climb up?

Central-eastern Hestrio Continent.{w}The fortress city of Bistel.{w}{p}A city promised prosperity by the Bistel royal family, the only ones on the continent who can hear the words of the Earth Goddess.{w}{p}With vast plains and mountains at its back and the sea at its front, it also serves as a key hub of maritime trade.{w}{p}Right now, the whole continent has its eyes on this city. The reason is a single 'Decree' issued by Bistel's queen, Ragnastia.{w}{p}The Decree announced that Fiona, the Earth Goddess, had lost her sovereignty to an awakened ancient evil spirit and was being driven from her place,{w}{p}and it promised whatever reward they wished to anyone who restored Fiona's sovereignty and banished the ancient evil spirit from the land.{w}{p}A notice board set up in a prominent spot at the center of the plaza bears the same words as the Decree.{w}
note: Accuracy: reworded so "was being driven from her place" clearly refers to Fiona, not the evil spirit (source: Fiona lost sovereignty and is being driven out).

en: "Interested in Lady Ragnastia's Decree?"{w}
Miria

"Oh, sorry to spring that on you. I'm Miria.{w}I work at this town's Training Hall, keeping the register of adventurers."{w}{p}"So whenever I see an adventurer I don't recognize, I just can't help calling out. Occupational hazard, I guess? Don't take it the wrong way."{w}{p}"I know! If you like, want me to show you around town?"{w}{p}"I've got errands to run at the adventurers' shops anyway. If you come along, you'll save yourself the trouble of finding them."{w}
Want a tour of Bistel?
"Huh? You're sure?"{w}
"Got it. See you later, then. I'll be waiting at the Training Hall."{w}
Miria left.{w}
"Okay, let's go! The Training Hall comes first."{w}

"Here we are. This is the first place you should come."{w}{p}"You're standing right there, but unless you register, we can't treat you as an adventurer, and you can't form a party either."{w}{p}"Register your real name, nickname, race, sex, personality and so on, and pick your class last."{w}{p}"There are basic, intermediate and advanced classes, but the bar for qualifying for an advanced class is high, so don't count on starting as one."{w}{p}"Well, if you dig in and take your time, you might get straight into an advanced class... but unless you're set on it, I wouldn't recommend it."{w}{p}"Okay, wait right there a sec."{w}
Miria's Voice
"Umm, the register, the register... Found it!"{w}
"Sorry to keep you waiting! Back to town."{w}
"My errand is to circulate this register to the shops. Once you register, you'll be in it too.{w}Next, let's go to Berte's Tavern."{w}
note: Pilot kept; only 'tavern' capitalised to match glossary entry Berte's Tavern.

en: "This is the tavern. Adventurers who register at the Training Hall all wait here. Including you and your friends, of course."{w}{p}"If you call on them to form a party, they'll all join you, as long as your personalities aren't too far apart."{w}
Berte
"Oh, Miria! Welcome!"{w}
"Hiya."{w}
"And who's this? A new adventurer, maybe?"{w}
"Yep. I found them in front of the notice board. I'm showing them around town while I make my rounds. Here's the latest register."{w}
"Thanks! Let's see...?"{w}
"It's gotten a bit shorter. Actually, there aren't any newcomers... Huh? What about the kids who registered just the other day?"{w}
"Squish, squish."{w}
"Again!?{w}Shouldn't you warn them beforehand?"{w}
"According to the director of our Training Hall, 'If they get crushed here, that's all they were ever going to be as adventurers. Better than dying somewhere more dangerous.'"{w}
"Th-that's harsh. If that's how it is, I'll keep my mouth shut, but... But still, but still..."{w}
"You end up with fewer customers, right? Sorry."{w}
note: Miria finishes Berte's trailing complaint: dead rookies mean fewer tavern customers.

en: "...Howeeever!{w}Right here, we have a promising newcomer!"{w}
"Oh, that's right!"{w}
You were grabbed by both shoulders.{w}
note: JP is passive with no agent. The scene implies Berte, but the row is a unique line that may recur elsewhere, so the agent is not named.

en: "Do your best, for my shop's sake too, okay?{w}...Run away or give up, and you'll be sorry."{w}
note: shouchi shinai = 'I won't stand for it'; rendered as a threat, not softened.

en: "Well, we'd better get going. I still have to drop in on Costo and Rosetta."{w}
"Okay. See you!"{w}
"Once you've formed a party, get yourselves properly equipped. This place is called the Kernel Shop, but...{w}Well, never mind. Go on in."{w}
note: Miria trails off (hesitating about the shopkeeper) and drops it.

en: Costo
"This is intolerable...{w}Why must I, of all people, run some item shop!? Flamberge or whatever it is, I've no idea..."{w}
"Hellooo!"{w}
"Lady Ragnastia goes too far, too!{w}There's no need to get so angry over a mere military budget!"{w}
"Ugh, there goes the griping again...{w}Hello? Costooo?"{w}
note: Subject of the griping left as a noun phrase to avoid a pronoun for Costo (gender not confirmed in glossary).

en: "Hm? Ah, it's you, Miria."{w}
"I'm circulating the adventurer register. Here you go."{w}
"I don't need it."{w}
"It's not about whether you need it or not. Please just look at it."{w}
"As if I'd look at it. Such a bother. By rights, I am not someone who belongs in a place like this!"{w}
"Oh, no, no, I don't think that's true at all."{w}
note: Teasing: she contradicts his claim that he doesn't belong in the shop.

en: "Honestly! What's all this about 'Collect 10,000,000 GP and learn the value of money'!? I'm the one who rebuilt the Administration Bureau, you know!"{w}
note: Inner quote (the Queen's order) in single quotes. GP kept as the game's currency abbreviation.

en: "Yes, yes, of course you did.{w}...Sigh. That's Costo for you. If it seems like a hassle, you don't have to talk to Costo at all."{w}
"By the way, you there. A rookie adventurer? Then I've got just the thing!"{w}{p}"It's called a Flamberge! Word is it's a seriously awesome weapon! Just for you, I'll sell it for 500,000 GP."{w}
note: soutou iketeru: Costo uses slang he half understands; 'seriously awesome' keeps it.

en: "H-hey, Costo! What do you think you're doing, ripping people off like that!?"{w}
"Ripping people off? What a nasty thing to accuse me of. Fine, then... 300,000 GP will do. Buy it."{w}
"That's not the point! How do you even come up with a price like that!? It's way too expensive!"{w}
"Expensive!? Hahaha, you can't be serious! 300,000 GP is gone after one meal and a little wine, isn't it?"{w}
"Th-there you go again... And the Queen only just told you that's exactly what's wrong with you."{w}
"Don't talk like you know it all!{w}Besides, this is my shop, isn't it? Then what's wrong with me setting the prices?"{w}
"Of course it's wrong!! This! Look at this! The Commerce Guild Price Agreement!!"{w}
note: New term: shoukou kumiai kakaku kyoutei = Commerce Guild Price Agreement.

en: "What's that? I've never seen it before."{w}
"Bistel's Chief Merchant came and explained it on your very first day!!"{w}
note: New title: shouchou = Chief Merchant (glossary has daishouchou = Grand Merchant for Walmitt; kept parallel).

en: "Did that happen?"{w}
"Honestly, geez. The Flamberge is... page 109. Isn't this it?"{w}
"Ah, the print's too small. I can't read it."{w}
"Then. Put. On. Some. GLASSES, why don't youuuuu!!"{w}
note: Syllable-by-syllable shout with rough imperative (kakero yo); word-by-word stress keeps the effect.

en: "All right, all right! I have a magnifying glass, okay!? Now then, let's see..."{w}
"That's the proper price."{w}
"Bwahahaha!! You can buy this sword for that kind of chump change!? That wouldn't even buy tea and cakes!!"{w}
"Th-that's a fortune! Talk about bourgeois!!"{w}
"I don't get it... I just don't get how you commoners think..."{w}
"Go. And. DIE!!{w}Forget it, let's go. If we keep dealing with this old geezer, we'll be here till sundown."{w}
note: isshen, shi.ne = 'go die once', spelled out; not softened. oyaji = old man/geezer: the source's own word (see report, gender evidence for Costo).

en: "Now see here, how about showing me a little more respect? I'll have you know I am..."{w}
"Yeah, yeah, on to the next one!"{w}

"Normally, the next step would be going to Bistel Castle so you can pay your respects to the Queen, but..."{w}{p}"That's one place I can't just casually show you around, so once you're done registering, go there on your own."{w}{p}"Next, I'll show you the inn, where you can rest."{w}
